question: Could you find out the average percentage of the total lifetime sales (LTV) that occur in the first 7 and 30 days after a customer's initial purchase? Also, include the average total lifetime sales (LTV). Please exclude customers with zero lifetime sales. The 7- and 30-day periods should be based on the exact number of hours-minutes-seconds, not calendar days.
sql:
WITH customer_ltv AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        SUM(amount) as total_ltv,
        MIN(payment_date) as first_payment
    FROM payment
    GROUP BY customer_id
    HAVING SUM(amount) > 0
),
customer_window_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        p.customer_id,
        cl.total_ltv,
        cl.first_payment,
        SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (p.payment_date - cl.first_payment)) / 3600.0 <= 168 THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END) as sales_first_7_days,
        SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (p.payment_date - cl.first_payment)) / 3600.0 <= 720 THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END) as sales_first_30_days
    FROM payment p
    JOIN customer_ltv cl ON p.customer_id = cl.customer_id
    GROUP BY p.customer_id, cl.total_ltv, cl.first_payment
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(AVG(sales_first_7_days / total_ltv * 100.0), 2) as avg_pct_first_7_days,
    ROUND(AVG(sales_first_30_days / total_ltv * 100.0), 2) as avg_pct_first_30_days,
    ROUND(AVG(total_ltv), 2) as avg_ltv
FROM customer_window_sales
